name: Jsp290.sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff
statement:
theorem sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff (a : Sequence) (s D : Finset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s ∩ D, a i) + (∑ i ∈ s \ D, a i) = ∑ i ∈ s, a i
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Disjoint (s ∩ D) (s \ D) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hi hj
    exact (mem_sdiff.mp hj).2 (mem_inter.mp hi).2
  have hu : (s ∩ D) ∪ (s \ D) = s := by
    ext i
    simp only [mem_union, mem_inter, mem_sdiff]
    tauto
  rw [← sum_union hd, hu]

name: Jsp290.deletion_extension_of_central
statement:
theorem deletion_extension_of_central {a : Sequence}
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i, C < a i)
    (h2 : ∀ E : Finset ℕ, E.card = 2 → CompleteAfter a E)
    {D : Finset ℕ} (hc : FiniteCentralAfter a D) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, j ∉ D ∧ CompleteAfter a (insert j D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push_neg at hn
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hcentral⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hu (2 * T + ∑ k ∈ D, a k)
  have hiD : i ∉ D := by
    intro hiD
    have hle : a i ≤ ∑ k ∈ D, a k := single_le_sum (fun k _ => ha k) hiD
    omega
  obtain ⟨F, hFD, hiF, hF⟩ := hcentral i hiD
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (D ∪ F)
  have hjD : j ∉ D := by aesop
  have hjF : j ∉ F := by aesop
  have hij : i ≠ j := by aesop
  have hcard : ({i, j} : Finset ℕ).card = 2 := by simp [hij]
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := h2 {i, j} hcard
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmissing⟩ := not_completeAfter_iff.mp (hn j hjD) (R + T)
  obtain ⟨s, hsdel, hs⟩ := hR (x - T) (by omega)
  have his : i ∉ s := by
    intro his
    exact disjoint_left.mp hsdel his (by simp)
  have hjs : j ∉ s := by
    intro hjs
    exact disjoint_left.mp hsdel hjs (by simp)
  let g := s ∩ D
  let f := (s \ D) ∩ F
  let q := (s \ D) \ F
  have hsplit : (∑ k ∈ g, a k) + (∑ k ∈ f, a k) +
      (∑ k ∈ q, a k) = x - T := by
    have h₁ := sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff a s D
    have h₂ := sum_inter_add_sum_sdiff a (s \ D) F
    dsimp [g, f, q]
    omega
  have hg0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ g, a k := sum_nonneg (fun k _ => ha k)
  have hf0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ f, a k := sum_nonneg (fun k _ => ha k)
  have hg : (∑ k ∈ g, a k) ≤ ∑ k ∈ D, a k := by
    apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    · exact inter_subset_right
    · intro k _ _
      exact ha k
  have hfsub : f ⊆ F.erase i := by
    intro k hk
    have hkF : k ∈ F := (mem_inter.mp hk).2
    have hks : k ∈ s := (mem_sdiff.mp (mem_inter.mp hk).1).1
    exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨by aesop, hkF⟩
  have hf : (∑ k ∈ f, a k) ≤ (∑ k ∈ F, a k) - a i := by
    have hle := sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hfsub (fun k _ _ => ha k)
    have heq := sum_erase_add F a hiF
    omega
  have hlower : T ≤ x - ∑ k ∈ q, a k := by omega
  have hupper : x - (∑ k ∈ q, a k) ≤ (∑ k ∈ F, a k) - T := by omega
  obtain ⟨t, htF, ht⟩ := hF (x - ∑ k ∈ q, a k) hlower hupper
  have htq : Disjoint t q := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro k hkt hkq
    exact (mem_sdiff.mp hkq).2 (htF hkt)
  apply hxmissing
  refine ⟨t ∪ q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro k hk hkd
    rcases mem_union.mp hk with hkt | hkq
    · have hkF := htF hkt
      rcases mem_insert.mp hkd with rfl | hkD
      · exact hjF hkF
      · exact disjoint_left.mp hFD hkF hkD
    · have hkSD := (mem_sdiff.mp hkq).1
      have hks := (mem_sdiff.mp hkSD).1
      have hkD := (mem_sdiff.mp hkSD).2
      rcases mem_insert.mp hkd with rfl | hkd
      · exact hjs hks
      · exact hkD hkd
  · rw [sum_union htq, ht]
    omega

name: Jsp290.completeAfter_of_smaller_card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hDE, hE⟩ := Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq D m hD
  exact (hm E hE).mono hDE

name: Jsp290.deletions_arbitrary_card_of_central
statement:
theorem deletions_arbitrary_card_of_central {a : Sequence}
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i, C < a i)
    (h2 : ∀ E : Finset ℕ, E.card = 2 → CompleteAfter a E)
    (hc : ∀ D : Finset ℕ, CompleteAfter a D → FiniteCentralAfter a D)
    (n : ℕ) : ∃ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = n ∧ CompleteAfter a D
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨∅, by simp, ?_⟩
    exact completeAfter_of_smaller_card h2 ∅ (by simp)
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨D, hD, hcomp⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨j, hjD, hj⟩ := deletion_extension_of_central ha hu h2 (hc D hcomp)
    exact ⟨insert j D, by simp [card_insert_of_notMem hjD, hD], hj⟩

name: Jsp290.prefixSum_ge_index
statement:
theorem prefixSum_ge_index {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (N : ℕ) :
    (N : ℤ) ≤ PrefixSum a N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [PrefixSum]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [prefixSum_succ]
    have := ha N
    push_cast
    omega

name: Jsp290.prefix_slack_after_one
statement:
theorem prefix_slack_after_one {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hm : Monotone a) {i N : ℕ} (hiN : i < N)
    (hrep : RepresentsAfter a {i} (PrefixSum a N - a i + 1)) :
    a N ≤ PrefixSum a N - a i + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  have hlt : PrefixSum a N - a i + 1 < a N := by omega
  obtain ⟨s, hsD, hs⟩ := hrep
  have his : i ∉ s := by
    intro his
    exact disjoint_left.mp hsD his (by simp)
  have hsub : s ⊆ (range N).erase i := by
    intro j hj
    refine mem_erase.mpr ⟨by aesop, mem_range.mpr ?_⟩
    by_contra hNj
    have hNj : N ≤ j := by omega
    have hjle : a j ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, a k := single_le_sum (fun k _ => ha k) hj
    have := hm hNj
    omega
  have hsum := sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun k _ _ => ha k)
  have heq := sum_erase_add (range N) a (mem_range.mpr hiN)
  change (∑ k ∈ (range N).erase i, a k) + a i = PrefixSum a N at heq
  omega

name: Jsp290.divergingSlack_of_one_deletion
statement:
theorem divergingSlack_of_one_deletion {a : Sequence}
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (hm : Monotone a)
    (hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i, C < a i)
    (h1 : ∀ i, CompleteAfter a {i}) : DivergingSlack a
proof:
:= by
  intro C
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hu C
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := h1 i
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_nat_ge (T + a i)
  refine ⟨max (i + 1) K, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  have hiN : i < N := by omega
  have hKN : (K : ℤ) ≤ (N : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast (show K ≤ N by omega)
  have hSN := prefixSum_ge_index ha N
  have hrep := hT (PrefixSum a N - a i + 1) (by omega)
  have hb := prefix_slack_after_one (fun k => (ha k).le) hm hiN hrep
  omega

name: Jsp290.divergingSlack_of_bounded
statement:
theorem divergingSlack_of_bounded {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    (hb : ∃ B : ℤ, ∀ i, a i ≤ B) : DivergingSlack a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hb
  intro C
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_nat_ge (C + B)
  refine ⟨K, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  have hKN : (K : ℤ) ≤ (N : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hSN := prefixSum_ge_index ha N
  have := hB N
  omega

name: Jsp290.prefixRep_zero
statement: theorem prefixRep_zero (a : Sequence) (N : ℕ) : PrefixRep a N 0
proof:
:= by

name: Jsp290.represents_zero

  ⟨∅, by simp⟩

name: Jsp290.PrefixRep.represents
statement:
theorem PrefixRep.represents {a : Sequence} {N : ℕ} {x : ℤ}
    (h : PrefixRep a N x) : Represents a x

name: Jsp290.PrefixRep.mono
statement:
theorem PrefixRep.mono {a : Sequence} {N M : ℕ} {x : ℤ}
    (h : PrefixRep a N x) (hNM : N ≤ M) : PrefixRep a M x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hx⟩ := h
  exact ⟨s, hs.trans (range_mono hNM), hx⟩

name: Jsp290.prefixSum_zero
statement: theorem prefixSum_zero (a : Sequence) : PrefixSum a 0 = 0
proof:

  simp [PrefixSum]

name: Jsp290.prefixSum_succ
statement:
theorem prefixSum_succ (a : Sequence) (N : ℕ) :
    PrefixSum a (N + 1) = PrefixSum a N + a N
proof:
:= by
  simp [PrefixSum, sum_range_succ]

name: Jsp290.prefixRep_total
statement:
theorem prefixRep_total (a : Sequence) (N : ℕ) :
    PrefixRep a N (PrefixSum a N)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨range N, Subset.rfl, rfl⟩

name: Jsp290.PrefixRep.complement
statement:
theorem PrefixRep.complement {a : Sequence} {N : ℕ} {x : ℤ}
    (h : PrefixRep a N x) : PrefixRep a N (PrefixSum a N - x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hx⟩ := h
  refine ⟨range N \ s, sdiff_subset, ?_⟩
  rw [sum_sdiff_eq_sub hs, hx]
  rfl

name: Jsp290.PrefixRep.complement_iff
statement:
theorem PrefixRep.complement_iff {a : Sequence} {N : ℕ} {x : ℤ} :
    PrefixRep a N (PrefixSum a N - x) ↔ PrefixRep a N x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using h.complement
  · exact PrefixRep.complement

name: Jsp290.PrefixRep.add_term
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hx⟩ := h
  have his : i ∉ s := by
    intro hi
    have := mem_range.mp (hs hi)
    omega
  refine ⟨insert i s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    rcases mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
    · exact mem_range.mpr hiM
    · exact mem_range.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (mem_range.mp (hs hj)) (by omega))
  · rw [sum_insert his, hx]
    omega

name: Jsp290.represents_iff_exists_prefix
statement:
theorem represents_iff_exists_prefix {a : Sequence} {x : ℤ} :
    Represents a x ↔ ∃ N, PrefixRep a N x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    refine ⟨s.sup id + 1, s, ?_, hs⟩
    intro i hi
    apply mem_range.mpr
    have : i ≤ s.sup id := le_sup (f := id) hi
    omega
  · rintro ⟨N, hN⟩
    exact hN.represents

name: Jsp290.prefixSum_nonneg
statement:
theorem prefixSum_nonneg {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ PrefixSum a N
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_nonneg (fun i _ => ha i)

name: Jsp290.prefixSum_mono
statement:
theorem prefixSum_mono {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) :
    Monotone (PrefixSum a)
proof:
:= by
  intro N M hNM
  exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (range_mono hNM) (fun i _ _ => ha i)

name: Jsp290.PrefixRep.nonneg
statement:
theorem PrefixRep.nonneg {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    {N : ℕ} {x : ℤ} (h : PrefixRep a N x) : 0 ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := h
  exact sum_nonneg (fun i _ => ha i)

name: Jsp290.PrefixRep.le_total
statement:
theorem PrefixRep.le_total {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    {N : ℕ} {x : ℤ} (h : PrefixRep a N x) : x ≤ PrefixSum a N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := h
  exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hs (fun i _ _ => ha i)

name: Jsp290.prefixRep_of_represents_lt
statement:
theorem prefixRep_of_represents_lt {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hm : Monotone a) {N : ℕ} {x : ℤ} (hx : Represents a x) (hlt : x < a N) :
    PrefixRep a N x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨s, ?_, hs⟩
  intro i hi
  apply mem_range.mpr
  by_contra hNi
  have hNi : N ≤ i := by omega
  have hai : a i ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, a j := single_le_sum (fun j _ => ha j) hi
  have := hm hNi
  omega

name: Jsp290.completeAfter_empty
statement: theorem completeAfter_empty {a : Sequence} : CompleteAfter a ∅ ↔ Complete a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [CompleteAfter, Complete, RepresentsAfter, Represents, disjoint_empty_right,
    true_and]

name: Jsp290.CompleteAfter.mono
statement:
theorem CompleteAfter.mono {a : Sequence} {D E : Finset ℕ}
    (h : CompleteAfter a E) (hDE : D ⊆ E) : CompleteAfter a D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := h
  refine ⟨T, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsum⟩ := hT x hx
  exact ⟨s, hs.mono_right hDE, hsum⟩

name: Jsp290.CompleteAfter.complete
statement:
theorem CompleteAfter.complete {a : Sequence} {D : Finset ℕ}
    (h : CompleteAfter a D) : Complete a
proof:
:=
  completeAfter_empty.mp (h.mono (empty_subset _))

name: Jsp290.not_completeAfter_iff
statement:
theorem not_completeAfter_iff {a : Sequence} {D : Finset ℕ} :
    ¬ CompleteAfter a D ↔ ∀ T : ℤ, ∃ x : ℤ, T ≤ x ∧ ¬ RepresentsAfter a D x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [CompleteAfter, not_exists, not_forall, exists_prop]

name: Jsp290.survivors_infinite
statement: theorem survivors_infinite (D : Finset ℕ) : {i : ℕ | i ∉ D}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  have h : {i : ℕ | i ∉ D} = (↑D : Set ℕ)ᶜ := by
    ext i
    simp
  rw [h]
  exact D.finite_toSet.infinite_compl

name: Jsp290.survivor_strictMono
statement: theorem survivor_strictMono (D : Finset ℕ) : StrictMono (survivor D)
proof:
:=
  Nat.nth_strictMono (survivors_infinite D)

name: Jsp290.survivor_not_mem
statement: theorem survivor_not_mem (D : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) : survivor D n ∉ D
proof:
:=
  Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite (survivors_infinite D) n

name: Jsp290.survivor_count
statement:
theorem survivor_count (D : Finset ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ∉ D) :
    survivor D (Nat.count (fun j => j ∉ D) i) = i
proof:
:=
  Nat.nth_count hi

name: Jsp290.represents_erase_iff
statement:
theorem represents_erase_iff (a : Sequence) (D : Finset ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    Represents (erase a D) x ↔ RepresentsAfter a D x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    refine ⟨s.image (survivor D), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro i hi hD
      obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
      exact survivor_not_mem D j hD
    · rw [Finset.sum_image]
      · exact hs
      · intro i _ j _ hij
        exact (survivor_strictMono D).injective hij
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hsum⟩
    let c : ℕ → ℕ := Nat.count (fun j => j ∉ D)
    have hnot : ∀ i ∈ s, i ∉ D := fun i hi => Finset.disjoint_left.mp hs hi
    have hleft : ∀ i ∈ s, survivor D (c i) = i := fun i hi => survivor_count D (hnot i hi)
    refine ⟨s.image c, ?_⟩
    calc
      ∑ i ∈ s.image c, erase a D i = ∑ i ∈ s, erase a D (c i) := by
        apply Finset.sum_image
        intro i hi j hj hij
        simpa only [hleft i hi, hleft j hj] using congrArg (survivor D) hij
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, a i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        change a (survivor D (c i)) = a i
        rw [hleft i hi]
      _ = x := hsum

name: Jsp290.complete_erase_iff
statement:
theorem complete_erase_iff (a : Sequence) (D : Finset ℕ) :
    Complete (erase a D) ↔ CompleteAfter a D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Complete, CompleteAfter, represents_erase_iff]

name: Jsp290.monotone_erase
statement:
theorem monotone_erase {a : Sequence} (ha : Monotone a) (D : Finset ℕ) :
    Monotone (erase a D)
proof:
:=
  ha.comp (survivor_strictMono D).monotone

name: Jsp290.positive_erase
statement:
theorem positive_erase {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (D : Finset ℕ) :
    ∀ i, 0 < erase a D i
proof: := fun i => ha (survivor D i)

name: Jsp290.sum_survivor_image
statement:
theorem sum_survivor_image (a : Sequence) (D : Finset ℕ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ (range N).image (survivor D), a i) = PrefixSum (erase a D) N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_image]
  · rfl
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    exact (survivor_strictMono D).injective hij

name: Jsp290.prefixRep_erase_image
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsum⟩ := h
  refine ⟨s.image (survivor D), Finset.image_subset_image hs, ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_image]
  · exact hsum
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    exact (survivor_strictMono D).injective hij

name: Jsp290.image_survivor_range
statement:
theorem image_survivor_range (D : Finset ℕ) (N : ℕ) :
    (range N).image (survivor D) = range (survivor D N) \ D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i
  constructor
  · intro hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
    exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr
      (survivor_strictMono D (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)), survivor_not_mem D j⟩
  · intro hi
    obtain ⟨hiN, hiD⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨Nat.count (fun j => j ∉ D) i, ?_, survivor_count D hiD⟩
    apply Finset.mem_range.mpr
    apply (survivor_strictMono D).lt_iff_lt.mp
    rw [survivor_count D hiD]
    exact Finset.mem_range.mp hiN

name: Jsp290.prefixSum_erase
statement:
theorem prefixSum_erase (a : Sequence) (D : Finset ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (hD : D ⊆ range (survivor D N)) :
    PrefixSum (erase a D) N = PrefixSum a (survivor D N) - ∑ i ∈ D, a i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold PrefixSum erase
  rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ hij => (survivor_strictMono D).injective hij)]
  rw [image_survivor_range]
  exact Finset.sum_sdiff_eq_sub hD

name: Jsp290.divergingSlack_erase
statement:
theorem divergingSlack_erase {a : Sequence} (ha : DivergingSlack a) (D : Finset ℕ) :
    DivergingSlack (erase a D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro C
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := ha (C + ∑ i ∈ D, a i)
  refine ⟨max N₀ (D.sup id + 1), ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  have he : N ≤ survivor D N := (survivor_strictMono D).id_le N
  have hD : D ⊆ range (survivor D N) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i ≤ D.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hi
    have hN' : D.sup id + 1 ≤ N := (le_max_right _ _).trans hN
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  have h := hN₀ (survivor D N) ((le_max_left _ _).trans (hN.trans he))
  rw [prefixSum_erase a D N hD]
  change C ≤ PrefixSum a (survivor D N) - (∑ i ∈ D, a i) - a (survivor D N)
  omega

name: Jsp290.representsAfter_of_constant_tail
statement:
theorem representsAfter_of_constant_tail {a : Sequence} {K : ℕ}
    (hK : ∀ n : ℕ, K ≤ n → a n = a K)
    {D : Finset ℕ} (hD : ∀ i ∈ D, K ≤ i)
    {x : ℤ} (hx : Represents a x) : RepresentsAfter a D x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hx
  let u := s ∩ range K
  let v := s \ range K
  let M := max K (D.sup id + 1)
  let w := Ico M (M + v.card)
  have huv : Disjoint u v := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hi hj
    exact (mem_sdiff.mp hj).2 (mem_inter.mp hi).2
  have huvs : u ∪ v = s := by
    ext i
    simp only [u, v, mem_union, mem_inter, mem_sdiff]
    tauto
  have hvsum : (∑ i ∈ v, a i) = (v.card : ℤ) * a K := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ v, a i) = ∑ _i ∈ v, a K := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        apply hK
        have := (mem_sdiff.mp hi).2
        simp only [mem_range] at this
        omega
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hKM : K ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
  have hwval : (∑ i ∈ w, a i) = (v.card : ℤ) * a K := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ w, a i) = ∑ _i ∈ w, a K := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        exact hK i (le_trans hKM (mem_Ico.mp hi).1)
      _ = _ := by simp [w]
  have huw : Disjoint u w := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hi hj
    have hilt := mem_range.mp (mem_inter.mp hi).2
    have hM := (mem_Ico.mp hj).1
    omega
  refine ⟨u ∪ w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hi hiD
    rcases mem_union.mp hi with hi | hi
    · have hilt := mem_range.mp (mem_inter.mp hi).2
      have := hD i hiD
      omega
    · have himax : i ≤ D.sup id := le_sup (f := id) hiD
      have hiM : M ≤ i := (mem_Ico.mp hi).1
      have hM : D.sup id + 1 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
      omega
  · rw [sum_union huw, hwval, ← hvsum, ← sum_union huv, huvs, hs]

name: Jsp290.completeAfter_of_constant_tail
statement:
theorem completeAfter_of_constant_tail {a : Sequence} {K : ℕ}
    (hK : ∀ n : ℕ, K ≤ n → a n = a K)
    {D : Finset ℕ} (hD : ∀ i ∈ D, K ≤ i)
    (hc : Complete a) : CompleteAfter a D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨T, fun x hx => representsAfter_of_constant_tail hK hD (hT x hx)⟩

name: Jsp290.exists_completeAfter_card_bounded
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := monotone_bounded_eventually_constant hm hb
  refine ⟨Ico K (K + n), by simp, ?_⟩
  exact completeAfter_of_constant_tail hK (fun i hi => (mem_Ico.mp hi).1) hc

name: Jsp290.central_intervals
statement:
theorem central_intervals {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a)
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x) (hd : DivergingSlack a) :
    CentralIntervals a T
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i : ℕ, C < a i
  · exact Central.central_intervals_unbounded hm ha hT hc hd hu
  · have hb : ∃ B : ℤ, ∀ i, a i ≤ B := by
      push_neg at hu
      exact hu
    exact central_intervals_bounded hm ha hb hc

name: Jsp290.finiteCentralAfter_of_slack
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀⟩ := (complete_erase_iff a D).mpr hc
  let T : ℤ := max 1 T₀
  have hT : 1 ≤ T := le_max_left _ _
  have hrep : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents (erase a D) x := by
    intro x hx
    exact hT₀ x ((le_max_right _ _).trans hx)
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := central_intervals (monotone_erase hm D)
    (positive_erase ha D) hT hrep (divergingSlack_erase hd D)
  refine ⟨T, hT, ?_⟩
  intro i hiD
  let k := Nat.count (fun j => j ∉ D) i
  let N := max N₀ (k + 1)
  refine ⟨(range N).image (survivor D), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro j hj hjD
    obtain ⟨l, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hj
    exact survivor_not_mem D l hjD
  · apply mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨k, mem_range.mpr ?_, survivor_count D hiD⟩
    have h : k + 1 ≤ N := le_max_right _ _
    omega
  · intro x hx hxupper
    rw [sum_survivor_image] at hxupper
    exact prefixRep_erase_image (hN₀ N (le_max_left _ _) x hx hxupper)

name: Jsp290.positive_deletions_arbitrary_card
statement:
theorem positive_deletions_arbitrary_card {a : Sequence}
    (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    (h2 : ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = 2 → CompleteAfter a D)
    (n : ℕ) : ∃ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = n ∧ CompleteAfter a D
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i : ℕ, C < a i
  · have h1 : ∀ i, CompleteAfter a {i} := by
      intro i
      exact completeAfter_of_smaller_card h2 {i} (by simp)
    have hd := divergingSlack_of_one_deletion ha hm hu h1
    exact deletions_arbitrary_card_of_central (fun i => le_of_lt (ha i)) hu h2
      (fun _ hc => finiteCentralAfter_of_slack hm ha hd hc) n
  · have hb : ∃ B : ℤ, ∀ i, a i ≤ B := by
      push_neg at hu
      exact hu
    have hc : Complete a :=
      (completeAfter_of_smaller_card h2 ∅ (by simp)).complete
    exact exists_completeAfter_card_bounded hm hb hc n

name: Jsp290.positive_exclusion
statement:
theorem positive_exclusion {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a)
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) {m n : ℕ} (hm2 : 2 ≤ m)
    (hrobust : ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = m → CompleteAfter a D)
    (hfail : ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = n → ¬ CompleteAfter a D) : False
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = 2 → CompleteAfter a D := by
    intro D hD
    exact completeAfter_of_smaller_card hrobust D (by omega)
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hc⟩ := positive_deletions_arbitrary_card hm ha h2 n
  exact hfail D hD hc

name: Jsp290.Central.prefixSum_strictMono
statement:
theorem prefixSum_strictMono {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) :
    StrictMono (PrefixSum a)
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro n
  rw [prefixSum_succ]
  exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ (ha n)

name: Jsp290.Central.locate_missing
statement:
theorem locate_missing {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x)
    {N : ℕ} {x : ℤ} (hx : T ≤ x) (hxN : x ≤ PrefixSum a N - T)
    (hmiss : ¬ PrefixRep a N x) :
    ∃ j < N, ∃ u : ℤ, 0 ≤ u ∧ u < T ∧ x = PrefixSum a j - u
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ i : ℕ, x + T ≤ PrefixSum a i := ⟨N, by omega⟩
  let i := Nat.find hex
  have hi : x + T ≤ PrefixSum a i := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hiN : i ≤ N := Nat.find_min' hex (by omega)
  have hi0 : 0 < i := by
    by_contra h
    have : i = 0 := by omega
    rw [this, prefixSum_zero] at hi
    omega
  let j := i - 1
  have hij : i = j + 1 := by omega
  have hj : j < i := by omega
  have hprev : PrefixSum a j < x + T := by
    have := Nat.find_min hex hj
    omega
  have hsum : PrefixSum a i = PrefixSum a j + a j := by
    rw [hij, prefixSum_succ]
  have hy : T ≤ PrefixSum a i - x := by omega
  have hlarge : a j ≤ PrefixSum a i - x := by
    by_contra h
    have hsmall : PrefixSum a i - x < a j := by omega
    have hr := prefixRep_of_represents_lt (fun t => le_of_lt (ha t)) hm (hc _ hy) hsmall
    have hh := (hr.mono (by omega : j ≤ i)).complement
    have hh : PrefixRep a i x := by convert hh using 1 <;> ring
    exact hmiss (hh.mono hiN)
  refine ⟨j, by omega, PrefixSum a j - x, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> omega

name: Jsp290.Central.finite_representations
statement:
theorem finite_representations (a : Sequence) (X : Finset ℤ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ X, Represents a x → PrefixRep a J x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction X using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | @insert x X hx ih =>
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := ih
    by_cases hr : Represents a x
    · obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := represents_iff_exists_prefix.mp hr
      refine ⟨max J K, ?_⟩
      intro y hy hry
      rcases mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
      · exact hK.mono (le_max_right _ _)
      · exact (hJ y hy hry).mono (le_max_left _ _)
    · refine ⟨J, ?_⟩
      intro y hy hry
      rcases mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy
      · exact (hr hry).elim
      · exact hJ y hy hry

name: Jsp290.Central.small_representations
statement:
theorem small_representations (a : Sequence) (T : ℤ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ x : ℤ, 0 ≤ x → x < T → Represents a x → PrefixRep a J x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := finite_representations a (Ico 0 T)
  exact ⟨J, fun x hx hxT hr => hJ x (mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hx, hxT⟩) hr⟩

name: Jsp290.Central.next_le_missing
statement:
theorem next_le_missing {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    {N : ℕ} {x : ℤ} (hx : Represents a x) (hmiss : ¬ PrefixRep a N x) : a N ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hmiss (prefixRep_of_represents_lt (fun i => le_of_lt (ha i)) hm hx (by omega))

name: Jsp290.Central.State.least_mem
statement:
theorem State.least_mem {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (s : State a T) :
    s.least ∈ s.labels
proof: := min'_mem _ _

name: Jsp290.Central.State.least_pos
statement: theorem State.least_pos {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (s : State a T) : 1 ≤ s.least
proof:
:=
  (s.label_spec _ s.least_mem).1

name: Jsp290.Central.State.least_lt
statement: theorem State.least_lt {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (s : State a T) : s.least < T
proof:
:=
  (s.label_spec _ s.least_mem).2.1

name: Jsp290.Central.State.potential_nonneg
statement:
theorem State.potential_nonneg {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (s : State a T) : 0 ≤ s.potential
proof:
:= by
  have hp := s.least_pos
  have hc : 0 ≤ (s.labels.card : ℤ) := by positivity
  unfold State.potential
  split_ifs <;> nlinarith

name: Jsp290.Central.State.potential_le
statement:
theorem State.potential_le {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (s : State a T) :
    s.potential ≤ (T + 1) * ((Ico (1 : ℤ) T).card + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : s.labels ⊆ Ico 1 T := by
    intro e he
    exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨(s.label_spec e he).1, (s.label_spec e he).2.1⟩
  have hc : (s.labels.card : ℤ) ≤ (Ico (1 : ℤ) T).card := by
    exact_mod_cast card_le_card hsub
  have hp := s.least_lt
  unfold State.potential
  split_ifs <;> nlinarith

name: Jsp290.Central.State.least_le
statement:
theorem State.least_le {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (s : State a T)
    {e : ℤ} (he : e ∈ s.labels) : s.least ≤ e
proof:
:=
  min'_le s.labels e he

name: Jsp290.Central.State.least_translate
statement:
theorem State.least_translate {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (s t : State a T) (c : ℤ)
    (hlabels : t.labels = s.labels.image (fun e => e + c)) : t.least = s.least + c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmem : s.least + c ∈ t.labels := by
    rw [hlabels]
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨s.least, s.least_mem, rfl⟩
  have hupper := t.least_le hmem
  have htmem := t.least_mem
  rw [hlabels] at htmem
  obtain ⟨e, he, heq⟩ := mem_image.mp htmem
  have hlower := s.least_le he
  omega

name: Jsp290.Central.State.potential_congr
statement:
theorem State.potential_congr {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (s t : State a T)
    (hlabels : t.labels = s.labels) (htype : t.Constant ↔ s.Constant) :
    t.potential = s.potential
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hleast : t.least = s.least := by
    have hh := t.least_le (show s.least ∈ t.labels by rw [hlabels]; exact s.least_mem)
    have hh' := s.least_le (show t.least ∈ s.labels by rw [← hlabels]; exact t.least_mem)
    omega
  by_cases hc : s.Constant
  · have htc := htype.mpr hc
    simp [State.potential, hc, htc, hlabels, hleast]
  · have htc : ¬ t.Constant := fun hh => hc (htype.mp hh)
    simp [State.potential, hc, htc, hlabels, hleast]

name: Jsp290.Central.State.normalization
statement:
theorem State.normalization {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (hm : Monotone a)
    (s : State a T) :
    ∃ t : State a T, t.Normalized ∧ t.labels = s.labels ∧
      (t.Constant ↔ s.Constant) ∧
      (∀ K, a K < a s.cut → K < t.cut)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hc : s.Constant
  · have hex : ∃ p, a p = a s.cut := ⟨s.cut, rfl⟩
    let p := Nat.find hex
    have hp : a p = a s.cut := Nat.find_spec hex
    have hpj : p ≤ s.cut := Nat.find_min' hex rfl
    have hcut : s.cut < s.last := s.cut_lt
    have hmiss : ∀ e ∈ s.labels, ¬ PrefixRep a (p + 1) (PrefixSum a p - e) := by
      intro e he hr
      by_cases hpeq : p = s.cut
      · apply s.missing e he
        simpa [hpeq] using hr.mono (by omega : p + 1 ≤ s.last)
      · have hpj' : p + 1 ≤ s.cut := by omega
        have hfirst : PrefixRep a (p + 1) (a p + e) := by
          have hh := hr.complement
          rw [prefixSum_succ] at hh
          convert hh using 1 <;> ring
        have hh := (hfirst.mono hpj').complement
        have hh := hh.add_term (le_refl s.cut) s.cut_lt
        apply s.missing e he
        convert hh using 1 <;> omega
    let t : State a T :=
      ⟨p, p + 1, s.labels, by omega, s.nonempty, s.label_spec, hmiss⟩
    have htc : t.Constant := by
      intro i hip hip'
      have : i = p := by change p ≤ i at hip; change i < p + 1 at hip'; omega
      subst i
      rfl
    refine ⟨t, ?_, rfl, iff_of_true htc hc, ?_⟩
    · intro _
      change p = 0 ∨ a (p - 1) < a p
      by_cases hp0 : p = 0
      · exact Or.inl hp0
      · right
        have hm' := hm (Nat.sub_le p 1)
        have hne : a (p - 1) ≠ a p := by
          intro heq
          have hh := Nat.find_min hex (show p - 1 < p by omega)
          exact hh (heq.trans hp)
        omega
    · intro K hK
      change K < p
      by_contra hh
      have hh := hm (show p ≤ K by omega)
      omega
  · refine ⟨s, (fun hh => (hc hh).elim), rfl, Iff.rfl, ?_⟩
    intro K hK
    by_contra hh
    have hh := hm (show s.cut ≤ K by omega)
    omega

name: Jsp290.Central.State.value_gap
statement:
theorem State.value_gap {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ}
    (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x)
    (s : State a T) (hlarge : T ≤ a s.cut)
    {v : ℤ} (hv : ∀ i, a i ≤ a s.cut ∨ v ≤ a i) :
    ∀ e ∈ s.labels, v - a s.cut ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro e he
  by_contra hbad
  have hepos := (s.label_spec e he).1
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hc (a s.cut + e) (by omega)
  have hsmall : ∀ i ∈ F, a i < a s.cut := by
    intro i hi
    have hle : a i ≤ ∑ k ∈ F, a k := single_le_sum (fun k _ => le_of_lt (ha k)) hi
    have hai : a i ≤ a s.cut := by
      rcases hv i with h | h
      · exact h
      · omega
    by_contra hn
    have heq : a i = a s.cut := by omega
    apply (s.label_spec e he).2.2
    refine ⟨F.erase i, ?_⟩
    have hh := sum_erase_add F a hi
    omega
  have hpre : PrefixRep a s.cut (a s.cut + e) := by
    refine ⟨F, ?_, hF⟩
    intro i hi
    apply mem_range.mpr
    by_contra hn
    have hh := hm (show s.cut ≤ i by omega)
    have hh' := hsmall i hi
    omega
  have hh := hpre.complement.add_term (le_refl s.cut) s.cut_lt
  apply s.missing e he
  convert hh using 1 <;> ring

name: Jsp290.Central.State.distinct_value
statement:
theorem State.distinct_value {a : Sequence} {T : ℤ} (hm : Monotone a)
    (s : State a T) (hc : ¬ s.Constant) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, s.cut < i ∧ i < s.last ∧ a s.cut < a i ∧
      (∀ k, a k ≤ a s.cut ∨ a i ≤ a k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ i, a s.cut < a i := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    apply hc
    intro i hi hi'
    exact le_antisymm (hn i) (hm hi)
  let i := Nat.find hex
  have hval : a s.cut < a i := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hj : s.cut < i := by
    by_contra hn
    have hh := hm (show i ≤ s.cut by omega)
    omega
  have hiN : i < s.last := by
    by_contra hn
    apply hc
    intro k hk hk'
    have hki : k < i := by omega
    have hh := Nat.find_min hex hki
    have hh' := hm hk
    omega
  refine ⟨i, hj, hiN, hval, ?_⟩
  intro k
  by_cases hki : i ≤ k
  · exact Or.inr (hm hki)
  · left
    have hh := Nat.find_min hex (show k < i by omega)
    omega

name: Jsp290.Central.align_cluster
statement:
theorem align_cluster {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x)
    {Q j : ℕ} (hsmall : ∀ u : ℤ, 0 ≤ u → u < T → Represents a u → PrefixRep a Q u)
    (hbig : 3 * T < a Q)
    (R : Finset ℤ) (hne : R.Nonempty)
    (hR : ∀ x ∈ R, T ≤ x ∧ PrefixSum a Q < x ∧
      x ≤ PrefixSum a j - T ∧ ¬ PrefixRep a j x)
    (hwidth : ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ y ∈ R, x - y ≤ 2 * T) :
    ∃ t : State a T, Q < t.cut ∧ t.last = j ∧
      t.labels = R.image (fun x => PrefixSum a t.cut - x) ∧
      t.labels.card = R.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsmono := prefixSum_mono (fun i => le_of_lt (ha i))
  have hloc : ∀ x ∈ R, ∃ l : ℕ, ∃ u : ℤ,
      Q < l ∧ l < j ∧ 1 ≤ u ∧ u < T ∧ ¬ Represents a u ∧ x = PrefixSum a l - u := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxT, hxQ, hxj, hxmiss⟩ := hR x hx
    obtain ⟨l, hlj, u, hu0, huT, hxu⟩ := locate_missing hm ha hT hc hxT hxj hxmiss
    have hQl : Q < l := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh := hsmono (show l ≤ Q by omega)
      omega
    have humiss : ¬ Represents a u := by
      intro hu
      have hh := (hsmall u hu0 huT hu).mono (le_of_lt hQl)
      have hh := hh.complement.mono (le_of_lt hlj)
      exact hxmiss (by simpa [hxu] using hh)
    have hu1 : 1 ≤ u := by
      by_contra hn
      have : u = 0 := by omega
      exact humiss (this ▸ represents_zero a)
    exact ⟨l, u, hQl, hlj, hu1, huT, humiss, hxu⟩
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨l, u₀, hQl, hlj, hu₀1, hu₀T, hu₀miss, hx₀u⟩ := hloc x₀ hx₀
  have haligned : ∀ x ∈ R, ∃ u : ℤ,
      1 ≤ u ∧ u < T ∧ ¬ Represents a u ∧ x = PrefixSum a l - u := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨k, u, hQk, hkj, hu1, huT, humiss, hxu⟩ := hloc x hx
    have hkl : k = l := by
      rcases lt_trichotomy k l with hlt | heq | hgt
      · have hs := hsmono (show k + 1 ≤ l by omega)
        rw [prefixSum_succ] at hs
        have hav := hm (le_of_lt hQk)
        have hw := hwidth x₀ hx₀ x hx
        omega
      · exact heq
      · have hs := hsmono (show l + 1 ≤ k by omega)
        rw [prefixSum_succ] at hs
        have hav := hm (le_of_lt hQl)
        have hw := hwidth x hx x₀ hx₀
        omega
    exact ⟨u, hu1, huT, humiss, by simpa [hkl] using hxu⟩
  let E := R.image (fun x => PrefixSum a l - x)
  have hE : E.Nonempty := ⟨PrefixSum a l - x₀, mem_image.mpr ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩⟩
  have hEspec : ∀ e ∈ E, 1 ≤ e ∧ e < T ∧ ¬ Represents a e := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp he
    obtain ⟨u, hu1, huT, humiss, hxu⟩ := haligned x hx
    have : PrefixSum a l - x = u := by omega
    simpa [this] using And.intro hu1 (And.intro huT humiss)
  have hEmiss : ∀ e ∈ E, ¬ PrefixRep a j (PrefixSum a l - e) := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp he
    have := (hR x hx).2.2.2
    convert this using 1 <;> ring
  let t : State a T := ⟨l, j, E, hlj, hE, hEspec, hEmiss⟩
  refine ⟨t, hQl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  change (R.image (fun x => PrefixSum a l - x)).card = R.card
  apply card_image_of_injective
  intro x y hxy
  change PrefixSum a l - x = PrefixSum a l - y at hxy
  omega

name: Jsp290.Central.constant_transition
statement:
theorem constant_transition {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x)
    {Q : ℕ} (hsmall : ∀ u : ℤ, 0 ≤ u → u < T → Represents a u → PrefixRep a Q u)
    (hbig : 3 * T < a Q) (hSQ : T ≤ PrefixSum a Q)
    (s : State a T) (hn : s.Normalized) (hconst : s.Constant)
    (hj : 0 < s.cut) (hterm : T ≤ a s.cut)
    (hslack : PrefixSum a Q + 2 * T < PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut) :
    ∃ t : State a T, Q < t.cut ∧ s.potential < t.potential
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := s.labels.image (fun e => PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut - e)
  have hRne : R.Nonempty := s.nonempty.image _
  have hR : ∀ x ∈ R, T ≤ x ∧ PrefixSum a Q < x ∧
      x ≤ PrefixSum a s.cut - T ∧ ¬ PrefixRep a s.cut x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨he1, heT, _⟩ := s.label_spec e he
    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    intro hr
    have hh := hr.add_term (le_refl s.cut) s.cut_lt
    apply s.missing e he
    convert hh using 1 <;> ring
  have hwidth : ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ y ∈ R, x - y ≤ 2 * T := by
    intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
    obtain ⟨he1, heT, _⟩ := s.label_spec e he
    obtain ⟨hf1, hfT, _⟩ := s.label_spec f hf
    omega
  obtain ⟨t, hQt, htlast, htlabels, htcard⟩ :=
    align_cluster hm ha hT hc hsmall hbig R hRne hR hwidth
  have htcut : t.cut < s.cut := by simpa [htlast] using t.cut_lt
  have hcard : t.labels.card = s.labels.card := by
    rw [htcard]
    change (s.labels.image (fun e => PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut - e)).card = _
    apply card_image_of_injective
    intro e f hef
    change PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut - e = PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut - f at hef
    omega
  have htranslate : t.labels = s.labels.image
      (fun e => e + (a s.cut - (PrefixSum a s.cut - PrefixSum a t.cut))) := by
    rw [htlabels]
    change (s.labels.image (fun e => PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut - e)).image
      (fun x => PrefixSum a t.cut - x) = _
    rw [image_image]
    congr 1
    funext e
    dsimp
    ring
  have hleast := s.least_translate t _ htranslate
  refine ⟨t, hQt, ?_⟩
  by_cases htc : t.Constant
  · have hprev : a (s.cut - 1) < a s.cut := by
      rcases hn hconst with hh | hh
      · omega
      · exact hh
    have hsame : a (s.cut - 1) = a t.cut := by
      apply htc
      · omega
      · rw [htlast]
        omega
    have hgapvalues : ∀ k, a k ≤ a t.cut ∨ a s.cut ≤ a k := by
      intro k
      by_cases hkj : k < s.cut
      · left
        have hh := hm (show k ≤ s.cut - 1 by omega)
        omega
      · exact Or.inr (hm (by omega))
    have htlargeterm : T ≤ a t.cut := by
      have hh := hm (le_of_lt hQt)
      omega
    have hgap := t.value_gap hm ha hc htlargeterm hgapvalues t.least t.least_mem
    have hleastT := s.least_lt
    have hsteplength : s.cut = t.cut + 1 := by
      by_contra hnstep
      have htwo : t.cut + 2 ≤ s.cut := by omega
      have hsum := prefixSum_mono (fun i => le_of_lt (ha i)) htwo
      have hsame' : a (t.cut + 1) = a t.cut := by
        apply htc
        · omega
        · rw [htlast]
          omega
      rw [show t.cut + 2 = (t.cut + 1) + 1 by omega,
        prefixSum_succ, prefixSum_succ, hsame'] at hsum
      have hav := hm (le_of_lt hQt)
      omega
    have hsum : PrefixSum a s.cut = PrefixSum a t.cut + a t.cut := by
      rw [hsteplength, prefixSum_succ]
    have hincr : s.least < t.least := by omega
    simp only [State.potential, if_pos hconst, if_pos htc, hcard]
    omega
  · have hleastT := s.least_lt
    simp only [State.potential, if_pos hconst, if_neg htc, hcard]
    nlinarith

name: Jsp290.Central.distinct_transition
statement:
theorem distinct_transition {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x)
    {Q : ℕ} (hsmall : ∀ u : ℤ, 0 ≤ u → u < T → Represents a u → PrefixRep a Q u)
    (hbig : 3 * T < a Q) (hSQ : T ≤ PrefixSum a Q)
    (s : State a T) (hconst : ¬ s.Constant) (hterm : T ≤ a s.cut)
    (hslack : PrefixSum a Q + 2 * T < PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut) :
    ∃ t : State a T, Q < t.cut ∧ s.potential < t.potential
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hji, hiN, hval, hvalues⟩ := s.distinct_value hm hconst
  have hgap := s.value_gap hm ha hc hterm hvalues s.least s.least_mem
  have hleastT := s.least_lt
  let F := s.labels.image (fun e => PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut - e)
  let G := s.labels.image (fun e => PrefixSum a s.cut - a i - e)
  let R := F ∪ G
  have hRne : R.Nonempty := (s.nonempty.image _).mono (subset_union_left : F ⊆ R)
  have hparam : ∀ x ∈ R, ∃ e ∈ s.labels, ∃ v : ℤ,
      a s.cut ≤ v ∧ v ≤ a s.cut + T ∧ x = PrefixSum a s.cut - v - e := by
    intro x hx
    rcases mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
    · obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
      exact ⟨e, he, a s.cut, le_rfl, by omega, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
      exact ⟨e, he, a i, by omega, by omega, rfl⟩
  have hR : ∀ x ∈ R, T ≤ x ∧ PrefixSum a Q < x ∧
      x ≤ PrefixSum a s.cut - T ∧ ¬ PrefixRep a s.cut x := by
    intro x hx
    have hbounds : T ≤ x ∧ PrefixSum a Q < x ∧ x ≤ PrefixSum a s.cut - T := by
      obtain ⟨e, he, v, hvlo, hvhi, hxe⟩ := hparam x hx
      obtain ⟨he1, heT, _⟩ := s.label_spec e he
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
    refine ⟨hbounds.1, hbounds.2.1, hbounds.2.2, ?_⟩
    intro hr
    rcases mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
    · obtain ⟨e, he, hxe⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
      have hh := hr.add_term (le_refl s.cut) s.cut_lt
      apply s.missing e he
      convert hh using 1 <;> omega
    · obtain ⟨e, he, hxe⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
      have hh := hr.add_term (le_of_lt hji) hiN
      apply s.missing e he
      convert hh using 1 <;> omega
  have hwidth : ∀ x ∈ R, ∀ y ∈ R, x - y ≤ 2 * T := by
    intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨e, he, v, hvlo, hvhi, hxe⟩ := hparam x hx
    obtain ⟨f, hf, w, hwlo, hwhi, hyf⟩ := hparam y hy
    obtain ⟨he1, heT, _⟩ := s.label_spec e he
    obtain ⟨hf1, hfT, _⟩ := s.label_spec f hf
    omega
  obtain ⟨t, hQt, htlast, htlabels, htcard⟩ :=
    align_cluster hm ha hT hc hsmall hbig R hRne hR hwidth
  have hcardF : F.card = s.labels.card := by
    apply card_image_of_injective
    intro e f hef
    change PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut - e = PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut - f at hef
    omega
  let emax := s.labels.max' s.nonempty
  have hemax : emax ∈ s.labels := max'_mem _ _
  let z := PrefixSum a s.cut - a i - emax
  have hzG : z ∈ G := mem_image.mpr ⟨emax, hemax, rfl⟩
  have hzF : z ∉ F := by
    intro hz
    obtain ⟨e, he, hez⟩ := mem_image.mp hz
    have hem : e ≤ emax := le_max' s.labels e he
    dsimp [z] at hez
    omega
  have hinsert : insert z F ⊆ R := by
    intro x hx
    rcases mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · exact mem_union_right F hzG
    · exact mem_union_left G hx
  have hcstrict : s.labels.card < t.labels.card := by
    have hh := card_le_card hinsert
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hzF, hcardF] at hh
    omega
  have hcstrict' : (s.labels.card : ℤ) + 1 ≤ t.labels.card := by exact_mod_cast hcstrict
  have htpos := t.least_pos
  refine ⟨t, hQt, ?_⟩
  unfold State.potential
  rw [if_neg hconst]
  split_ifs <;> nlinarith

name: Jsp290.Central.uniform_transition
statement:
theorem uniform_transition {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x)
    (hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i : ℕ, C < a i) (hd : DivergingSlack a) :
    ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ s : State a T, s.Normalized → J ≤ s.cut →
      ∃ t : State a T, t.Normalized ∧ K ≤ t.cut ∧ s.potential < t.potential
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K
  obtain ⟨Jrep, hrep⟩ := small_representations a T
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hu (max (3 * T) (a K))
  let Q := max (i + 1) Jrep
  have hiQ : i + 1 ≤ Q := le_max_left _ _
  have hrepQ : Jrep ≤ Q := le_max_right _ _
  have hQa := hm (show i ≤ Q by omega)
  have hbig : 3 * T < a Q := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) (lt_of_lt_of_le hi hQa)
  have hKbig : a K < a Q := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) (lt_of_lt_of_le hi hQa)
  have hsmall : ∀ u : ℤ, 0 ≤ u → u < T → Represents a u → PrefixRep a Q u :=
    fun u hu0 huT hr => (hrep u hu0 huT hr).mono hrepQ
  have hSQ : T ≤ PrefixSum a Q := by
    have hh := prefixSum_mono (fun k => le_of_lt (ha k)) hiQ
    rw [prefixSum_succ] at hh
    have hh' := prefixSum_nonneg (fun k => le_of_lt (ha k)) i
    have hhi : 3 * T < a i := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hi
    omega
  obtain ⟨Jslack, hslack⟩ := hd (PrefixSum a Q + 2 * T + 1)
  refine ⟨max Jslack (Q + 1), ?_⟩
  intro s hn hs
  have hsJ : Jslack ≤ s.cut := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hs
  have hsQ : Q + 1 ≤ s.cut := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hs
  have hterm : T ≤ a s.cut := by
    have hh := hm (show Q ≤ s.cut by omega)
    omega
  have hslack' : PrefixSum a Q + 2 * T < PrefixSum a s.cut - a s.cut := by
    have hh := hslack s.cut hsJ
    omega
  have hstep : ∃ t : State a T, Q < t.cut ∧ s.potential < t.potential := by
    by_cases hcst : s.Constant
    · exact constant_transition hm ha hT hc hsmall hbig hSQ s hn hcst (by omega) hterm hslack'
    · exact distinct_transition hm ha hT hc hsmall hbig hSQ s hcst hterm hslack'
  obtain ⟨t, htQ, hpot⟩ := hstep
  obtain ⟨t', htn, hlabels, htype, hcut⟩ := t.normalization hm
  have hlarge : a K < a t.cut := lt_of_lt_of_le hKbig (hm (le_of_lt htQ))
  have hpoteq := t.potential_congr t' hlabels htype
  exact ⟨t', htn, le_of_lt (hcut K hlarge), by omega⟩

name: Jsp290.Central.unbounded_states_of_failure
statement:
theorem unbounded_states_of_failure {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i)
    {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x)
    (hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i : ℕ, C < a i) (hn : ¬ CentralIntervals a T) :
    ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ s : State a T, s.Normalized ∧ K ≤ s.cut
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hbad : ∀ N₀ : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N ∧ ∃ x : ℤ,
      T ≤ x ∧ x ≤ PrefixSum a N - T ∧ ¬ PrefixRep a N x := by
    simpa only [CentralIntervals, not_exists, not_forall, Classical.not_imp, exists_prop] using hn
  intro K
  obtain ⟨Jrep, hrep⟩ := small_representations a T
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hu (a K)
  let L := max Jrep i
  have hrepL : Jrep ≤ L := le_max_left _ _
  have hiL : i ≤ L := le_max_right _ _
  have hLbig : a K < a L := lt_of_lt_of_le hi (hm hiL)
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := hu (PrefixSum a L)
  obtain ⟨N, hNN, x, hxT, hxN, hxmiss⟩ := hbad N₀
  have hNx : a N ≤ x := next_le_missing hm ha (hc x hxT) hxmiss
  have hNL : PrefixSum a L < a N := lt_of_lt_of_le hN₀ (hm hNN)
  obtain ⟨j, hjN, u, hu0, huT, hxu⟩ := locate_missing hm ha hT hc hxT hxN hxmiss
  have hLj : L < j := by
    by_contra hh
    have hh' := prefixSum_mono (fun k => le_of_lt (ha k)) (show j ≤ L by omega)
    omega
  have humiss : ¬ Represents a u := by
    intro hr
    have hh := (hrep u hu0 huT hr).mono (le_trans hrepL (le_of_lt hLj))
    have hh := hh.complement.mono (le_of_lt hjN)
    exact hxmiss (by simpa [hxu] using hh)
  have hu1 : 1 ≤ u := by
    by_contra hh
    have : u = 0 := by omega
    exact humiss (this ▸ represents_zero a)
  let s : State a T :=
    { cut := j
      last := N
      labels := {u}
      cut_lt := hjN
      nonempty := singleton_nonempty u
      label_spec := by intro e he; simp only [mem_singleton] at he; subst e; exact ⟨hu1, huT, humiss⟩
      missing := by intro e he; simp only [mem_singleton] at he; subst e; simpa [← hxu] using hxmiss }
  obtain ⟨t, htn, _, _, htcut⟩ := s.normalization hm
  have hlarge : a K < a s.cut := lt_of_lt_of_le hLbig (hm (le_of_lt hLj))
  exact ⟨t, htn, le_of_lt (htcut K hlarge)⟩

name: Jsp290.Central.bounded_potential_no_unbounded_states
statement:
theorem bounded_potential_no_unbounded_states {S : Type*} (cut : S → ℕ) (pot : S → ℤ)
    (M : ℤ) (hbound : ∀ s, pot s ≤ M)
    (hgrow : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ s : S, J ≤ cut s →
      ∃ s' : S, K ≤ cut s' ∧ pot s < pot s')
    (hpos : ∀ s : S, 0 ≤ pot s) : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ s : S, cut s < K
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  push_neg at hn
  have harb : ∀ p : ℕ, ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ s : S, K ≤ cut s ∧ (p : ℤ) ≤ pot s := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | zero =>
      intro K
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hn K
      exact ⟨s, hs, by simpa using hpos s⟩
    | succ p ih =>
      intro K
      obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := hgrow K
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hp⟩ := ih J
      obtain ⟨s', hs', hh⟩ := hJ s hs
      exact ⟨s', hs', by push_cast; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨s, _, hs⟩ := harb (M.toNat + 1) 0
  have hh := hbound s
  have hnM : M ≤ (M.toNat : ℤ) := Int.self_le_toNat M
  push_cast at hs
  omega

name: Jsp290.Central.central_intervals_unbounded
statement:
theorem central_intervals_unbounded {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a)
    (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) {T : ℤ} (hT : 1 ≤ T)
    (hc : ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x → Represents a x)
    (hd : DivergingSlack a) (hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i : ℕ, C < a i) :
    CentralIntervals a T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := {s : State a T // s.Normalized}
  let M : ℤ := (T + 1) * ((Ico (1 : ℤ) T).card + 1)
  have hgrow : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ s : S, J ≤ s.val.cut →
      ∃ t : S, K ≤ t.val.cut ∧ s.val.potential < t.val.potential := by
    intro K
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := uniform_transition hm ha hT hc hu hd K
    refine ⟨J, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨t, htn, hKt, hpot⟩ := hJ s.val s.property hs
    exact ⟨⟨t, htn⟩, hKt, hpot⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := bounded_potential_no_unbounded_states
    (fun s : S => s.val.cut) (fun s : S => s.val.potential) M
    (fun s => s.val.potential_le hT) hgrow (fun s => s.val.potential_nonneg hT)
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨s, hsn, hKs⟩ := unbounded_states_of_failure hm ha hT hc hu hn K
  have hh := hK ⟨s, hsn⟩
  change s.cut < K at hh
  omega

name: Jsp290.brown_prefix
statement:
theorem brown_prefix (a : Sequence) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    (hstep : ∀ i, a i ≤ PrefixSum a i + 1) :
    ∀ N x, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ PrefixSum a N → PrefixRep a N x
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro x hx hxN
    have : x = 0 := by simpa [PrefixSum] using le_antisymm hxN hx
    subst x
    exact prefixRep_zero a 0
  | succ N ih =>
    intro x hx hxN
    rw [prefixSum_succ] at hxN
    by_cases h : x ≤ PrefixSum a N
    · exact (ih x hx h).mono (Nat.le_succ N)
    · have hxlo : 0 ≤ x - a N := by have := hstep N; omega
      have hxhi : x - a N ≤ PrefixSum a N := by omega
      have hh := (ih (x - a N) hxlo hxhi).add_term (le_refl N) (Nat.lt_succ_self N)
      simpa using hh

name: Jsp290.prefixSum_ge_index_of_one_le
statement:
theorem prefixSum_ge_index_of_one_le (a : Sequence) (hpos : ∀ i, 1 ≤ a i) (N : ℕ) :
    (N : ℤ) ≤ PrefixSum a N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [PrefixSum]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [prefixSum_succ]
    have := hpos N
    push_cast
    omega

name: Jsp290.erased_nonneg
statement:
theorem erased_nonneg {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (D : Finset ℕ) :
    ∀ i, 0 ≤ erasedSequence a D i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp only [erasedSequence]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: Jsp290.erased_represents
statement:
theorem erased_represents {a : Sequence} {D : Finset ℕ} {x : ℤ}
    (h : Represents (erasedSequence a D) x) : RepresentsAfter a D x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h
  refine ⟨s.filter (fun i => i ∉ D), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact disjoint_left.mpr (fun i hi hD => (mem_filter.mp hi).2 hD)
  · rw [sum_filter]
    convert hs using 1
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    by_cases hD : i ∈ D <;> simp [erasedSequence, hD]

name: Jsp290.erased_singleton_prefix
statement:
theorem erased_singleton_prefix (a : Sequence) (j N : ℕ) :
    PrefixSum (erasedSequence a {j}) N =
      PrefixSum a N - if j < N then a j else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [PrefixSum]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [prefixSum_succ, prefixSum_succ, ih]
    by_cases hj : j = N
    · subst j
      simp [erasedSequence]
    · by_cases hjN : j < N
      · have hjN' : j < N + 1 := by omega
        simp [erasedSequence, hj, Ne.symm hj, hjN, hjN', sub_add_eq_add_sub]
      · have hjN' : ¬j < N + 1 := by omega
        simp [erasedSequence, hj, Ne.symm hj, hjN, hjN']

name: Jsp290.subset_range_of_sum_lt
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  apply mem_range.mpr
  by_contra hn
  have hNi : N ≤ i := by omega
  have := single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ s) => hpos j) hi
  have := hmono hNi
  omega

name: Jsp290.sum_add_omitted_le_prefix
statement:
theorem sum_add_omitted_le_prefix {a : Sequence} (hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    {s : Finset ℕ} {N i : ℕ} (hs : s ⊆ range N) (hiN : i < N) (his : i ∉ s) :
    (∑ j ∈ s, a j) + a i ≤ PrefixSum a N
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : insert i s ⊆ range N := insert_subset (mem_range.mpr hiN) hs
  have h := sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun j _ _ => hpos j)
  simpa [sum_insert his, PrefixSum, add_comm] using h

name: Jsp290.binary_pos
statement: theorem binary_pos (i : ℕ) : 1 ≤ binarySequence i
proof:
:= by
  exact one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2)

name: Jsp290.binary_mono
statement: theorem binary_mono : Monotone binarySequence
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) ≤ 2) hij

name: Jsp290.binary_prefix
statement: theorem binary_prefix (N : ℕ) : PrefixSum binarySequence N = binarySequence N - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [PrefixSum, binarySequence]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [prefixSum_succ, ih]
    simp [binarySequence, pow_succ]
    ring

name: Jsp290.binary_growth
statement: theorem binary_growth (j k : ℕ) : binarySequence j + k ≤ binarySequence (j + k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hp := binary_pos (j + k)
    have he : binarySequence (j + (k + 1)) = 2 * binarySequence (j + k) := by
      change (2 : ℤ) ^ (j + (k + 1)) = 2 * 2 ^ (j + k)
      rw [show j + (k + 1) = (j + k) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [he]
    push_cast
    omega

name: Jsp290.binary_complete
statement: theorem binary_complete : Complete binarySequence
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hsum : x ≤ PrefixSum binarySequence x.toNat := by
    have h := prefixSum_ge_index_of_one_le binarySequence binary_pos x.toNat
    omega
  exact (brown_prefix binarySequence (fun i => le_trans (by norm_num) (binary_pos i))
    (fun i => by rw [binary_prefix]; omega) x.toNat x hx hsum).represents

name: Jsp290.binary_delete_one
statement: theorem binary_delete_one (j : ℕ) : ¬ CompleteAfter binarySequence {j}
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_completeAfter_iff]
  intro T
  let N := j + (T.toNat + 1)
  let x := binarySequence N - binarySequence j
  have hlarge : T ≤ x := by
    have h := binary_growth j (T.toNat + 1)
    dsimp [x, N]
    push_cast at h
    omega
  refine ⟨x, hlarge, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨s, hsD, hsx⟩
  have hj : j ∉ s := by simpa [disjoint_singleton_right] using hsD
  have hxN : x < binarySequence N := by
    dsimp [x]
    have := binary_pos j
    omega
  have hsub := subset_range_of_sum_lt
    (fun i => le_trans (by norm_num) (binary_pos i)) binary_mono
      (show ∑ i ∈ s, binarySequence i < binarySequence N by rw [hsx]; exact hxN)
  have hsum := sum_add_omitted_le_prefix
    (fun i => le_trans (by norm_num) (binary_pos i)) hsub (by dsimp [N]; omega) hj
  rw [hsx, binary_prefix] at hsum
  dsimp [x] at hsum
  omega

name: Jsp290.fibonacci_pos
statement: theorem fibonacci_pos (i : ℕ) : 1 ≤ fibonacciSequence i
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 < Nat.fib (i + 1) := Nat.fib_pos.mpr (by omega)
  dsimp [fibonacciSequence]
  omega

name: Jsp290.fibonacci_mono
statement: theorem fibonacci_mono : Monotone fibonacciSequence
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  dsimp [fibonacciSequence]
  exact_mod_cast Nat.fib_mono (Nat.add_le_add_right hij 1)

name: Jsp290.fibonacci_recurrence
statement:
theorem fibonacci_recurrence (i : ℕ) :
    fibonacciSequence (i + 2) = fibonacciSequence i + fibonacciSequence (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.fib_add_two (n := i + 1)
  dsimp [fibonacciSequence]
  exact_mod_cast h

name: Jsp290.fibonacci_prefix
statement:
theorem fibonacci_prefix (N : ℕ) :
    PrefixSum fibonacciSequence N = fibonacciSequence (N + 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [PrefixSum, fibonacciSequence]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [prefixSum_succ, ih]
    have h := fibonacci_recurrence N
    norm_num only [Nat.add_assoc] at *
    omega

name: Jsp290.fibonacci_prefix_two
statement:
theorem fibonacci_prefix_two (N : ℕ) :
    PrefixSum fibonacciSequence (N + 2) =
      PrefixSum fibonacciSequence N + fibonacciSequence (N + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show N + 2 = (N + 1) + 1 by omega, prefixSum_succ, prefixSum_succ]
  have h := fibonacci_recurrence N
  norm_num only [Nat.add_assoc] at *
  omega

name: Jsp290.fibonacci_delete_one
statement: theorem fibonacci_delete_one (j : ℕ) : CompleteAfter fibonacciSequence {j}
proof:
:= by
  let a := erasedSequence fibonacciSequence {j}
  have hpos : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i :=
    erased_nonneg (fun i => le_trans (by norm_num) (fibonacci_pos i)) _
  have hstep : ∀ i, a i ≤ PrefixSum a i + 1 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      have haj : a j = 0 := by simp [a, erasedSequence]
      rw [haj]
      have := prefixSum_nonneg hpos j
      omega
    · rw [show a i = fibonacciSequence i by simp [a, erasedSequence, hij]]
      rw [show PrefixSum a i = _ from erased_singleton_prefix fibonacciSequence j i,
        fibonacci_prefix]
      by_cases hji : j < i
      · rw [if_pos hji]
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : i ≠ 0)
        have hmono := fibonacci_mono (show j ≤ k by omega)
        have hrec := fibonacci_recurrence k
        norm_num only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] at *
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hji]
        have := fibonacci_mono (Nat.le_succ i)
        simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at *
        omega
  refine ⟨0, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  let N := (x + fibonacciSequence j).toNat
  have hxsum : x ≤ PrefixSum a N := by
    rw [show PrefixSum a N = _ from erased_singleton_prefix fibonacciSequence j N]
    have h := prefixSum_ge_index_of_one_le fibonacciSequence fibonacci_pos N
    have hp := fibonacci_pos j
    have hN : x + fibonacciSequence j ≤ (N : ℤ) := by dsimp [N]; omega
    split_ifs <;> omega
  exact erased_represents (brown_prefix a hpos hstep N x hx hxsum).represents

name: Jsp290.fibonacci_pair_missing
statement:
theorem fibonacci_pair_missing (i j : ℕ) (hij : i < j) (t : ℕ) :
    ¬ RepresentsAfter fibonacciSequence {i, j} (PrefixSum fibonacciSequence (j + 2 * t))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ k, 0 ≤ fibonacciSequence k :=
    fun k => le_trans (by norm_num) (fibonacci_pos k)
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero]
    rintro ⟨s, hD, hsum⟩
    have hj : j ∉ s := fun hj => disjoint_left.mp hD hj (by simp)
    have hi : i ∉ s := fun hi => disjoint_left.mp hD hi (by simp)
    have hlt : ∑ k ∈ s, fibonacciSequence k < fibonacciSequence (j + 1) := by
      rw [hsum, fibonacci_prefix]
      omega
    have hsub := subset_range_of_sum_lt hp fibonacci_mono hlt
    have hsub' : s ⊆ range j := by
      intro k hk
      have hkr := mem_range.mp (hsub hk)
      have hkj : k ≠ j := fun h => hj (h ▸ hk)
      exact mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    have h := sum_add_omitted_le_prefix hp hsub' hij hi
    rw [hsum] at h
    have := fibonacci_pos i
    omega
  | succ t ih =>
    let k := j + 2 * t
    have htarget : j + 2 * (t + 1) = k + 2 := by dsimp [k]; omega
    rw [htarget]
    rintro ⟨s, hD, hsum⟩
    have hi : i ∉ s := fun hi => disjoint_left.mp hD hi (by simp)
    have hlt : ∑ r ∈ s, fibonacciSequence r < fibonacciSequence (k + 2 + 1) := by
      rw [hsum, fibonacci_prefix]
      omega
    have hsub := subset_range_of_sum_lt hp fibonacci_mono hlt
    have hk : k + 2 ∈ s := by
      by_contra hh
      have hsub' : s ⊆ range (k + 2) := by
        intro r hr
        have hrr := mem_range.mp (hsub hr)
        have hrk : r ≠ k + 2 := fun h => hh (h ▸ hr)
        exact mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have h := sum_add_omitted_le_prefix hp hsub' (by dsimp [k]; omega) hi
      rw [hsum] at h
      have := fibonacci_pos i
      omega
    apply ih
    refine ⟨s.erase (k + 2), hD.mono_left (erase_subset _ _), ?_⟩
    have he := sum_erase_add s fibonacciSequence hk
    rw [hsum, fibonacci_prefix_two] at he
    change ∑ r ∈ s.erase (k + 2), fibonacciSequence r = PrefixSum fibonacciSequence k
    omega

name: Jsp290.fibonacci_delete_pair
statement:
theorem fibonacci_delete_pair (i j : ℕ) (hij : i < j) :
    ¬ CompleteAfter fibonacciSequence {i, j}
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_completeAfter_iff]
  intro T
  refine ⟨PrefixSum fibonacciSequence (j + 2 * T.toNat), ?_,
    fibonacci_pair_missing i j hij T.toNat⟩
  have h := prefixSum_ge_index_of_one_le fibonacciSequence fibonacci_pos (j + 2 * T.toNat)
  omega

name: Jsp290.admissible_zero
statement: theorem admissible_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : Admissible 0 n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨binarySequence, binary_mono, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro D hD
    have : D = ∅ := card_eq_zero.mp hD
    subst D
    exact completeAfter_empty.mpr binary_complete
  · intro D hD hC
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := card_pos.mp (show 0 < D.card by omega)
    exact binary_delete_one j (hC.mono (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hj))

name: Jsp290.admissible_one
statement: theorem admissible_one (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) : Admissible 1 n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fibonacciSequence, fibonacci_mono, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro D hD
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := card_eq_one.mp hD
    exact fibonacci_delete_one j
  · intro D hD hC
    obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij⟩ := one_lt_card.mp (show 1 < D.card by omega)
    have hpair : {i, j} ⊆ D := insert_subset hi (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hj)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hij | hji
    · exact fibonacci_delete_pair i j hij (hC.mono hpair)
    · have hpair' : {j, i} ⊆ D := insert_subset hj (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hi)
      exact fibonacci_delete_pair j i hji (hC.mono hpair')

name: Jsp290.admissible_of_le_one
statement:
theorem admissible_of_le_one (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m < n) (hm : m ≤ 1) :
    Admissible m n
proof:
:= by
  have : m = 0 ∨ m = 1 := by omega
  rcases this with rfl | rfl
  · exact admissible_zero n hmn
  · exact admissible_one n hmn

name: Jsp290.negateAt_involutive
statement:
theorem negateAt_involutive (a : Sequence) (j : ℕ) :
    negateAt (negateAt a j) j = a
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst i; simp [negateAt]
  · simp [negateAt, h]

name: Jsp290.representsAfter_negateAt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hx⟩ := h
  by_cases hjs : j ∈ s
  · refine ⟨s.erase j, hs.mono_left (Finset.erase_subset _ _), ?_⟩
    calc
      ∑ i ∈ s.erase j, negateAt a j i = ∑ i ∈ s.erase j, a i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        exact Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi) _ _
      _ = x - a j := by
        have he := Finset.sum_erase_add s a hjs
        rw [hx] at he
        omega
  · refine ⟨insert j s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.disjoint_insert_left]
      exact ⟨hj, hs⟩
    · rw [Finset.sum_insert hjs]
      have he : ∑ i ∈ s, negateAt a j i = ∑ i ∈ s, a i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hij : i ≠ j := by intro hij; exact hjs (hij ▸ hi)
        exact Function.update_of_ne hij _ _
      rw [he, hx]
      simp [negateAt, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]

name: Jsp290.completeAfter_negateAt
statement:
theorem completeAfter_negateAt {a : Sequence} {D : Finset ℕ} (j : ℕ)
    (h : CompleteAfter a D) : CompleteAfter (negateAt a j) D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := h
  by_cases hj : j ∈ D
  · refine ⟨T, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsum⟩ := hT x hx
    refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
    calc
      ∑ i ∈ s, negateAt a j i = ∑ i ∈ s, a i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hij : i ≠ j := by
          intro hij
          exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hs hi (hij ▸ hj)
        exact Function.update_of_ne hij _ _
      _ = x := hsum
  · refine ⟨T - a j, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hrep := representsAfter_negateAt hj (hT (x + a j) (by omega))
    simpa using hrep

name: Jsp290.completeAfter_negateAt_iff
statement:
theorem completeAfter_negateAt_iff (a : Sequence) (D : Finset ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
    CompleteAfter (negateAt a j) D ↔ CompleteAfter a D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [negateAt_involutive] using completeAfter_negateAt j h
  · exact completeAfter_negateAt j

name: Jsp290.completeAfter_flipSigns_iff
statement:
theorem completeAfter_flipSigns_iff (a : Sequence) (D S : Finset ℕ) :
    CompleteAfter (flipSigns a S) D ↔ CompleteAfter a D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    have he : flipSigns a ∅ = a := by
      funext i
      simp only [flipSigns, Finset.notMem_empty, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [he]
  | @insert j S hj ih =>
    have he : flipSigns a (insert j S) = negateAt (flipSigns a S) j := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = j
      · subst i; simp [flipSigns, negateAt, hj]
      · simp [flipSigns, negateAt, hi]
    rw [he, completeAfter_negateAt_iff, ih]

name: Jsp290.completeAfter_abs_iff
statement:
theorem completeAfter_abs_iff (a : Sequence) (K : ℕ)
    (hK : ∀ i, K ≤ i → 0 ≤ a i) (D : Finset ℕ) :
    CompleteAfter (fun i => |a i|) D ↔ CompleteAfter a D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := (range K).filter (fun i => a i < 0)
  have he : (fun i => |a i|) = flipSigns a S := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : a i < 0
    · have hiK : i < K := by
        by_contra hn
        have := hK i (by omega)
        omega
      simp [flipSigns, S, hi, hiK, abs_of_neg hi]
    · simp [flipSigns, S, hi, abs_of_nonneg (by omega : 0 ≤ a i)]
  rw [he]
  exact completeAfter_flipSigns_iff a D S

name: Jsp290.representsAfter_reindex_iff
statement:
theorem representsAfter_reindex_iff (a : Sequence) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range f → a i = 0)
    (D : Finset ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    RepresentsAfter (fun i => a (f i)) D x ↔ RepresentsAfter a (D.image f) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hsum⟩
    refine ⟨s.image f, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro i hi hD
      obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hkj⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hD
      have hkj' := hf hkj
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hs hj (hkj' ▸ hk)
    · rw [Finset.sum_image]
      · exact hsum
      · exact fun _ _ _ _ h => hf h
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hsum⟩
    refine ⟨s.preimage f hf.injOn, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro i hi hD
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hs (Finset.mem_preimage.mp hi)
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hD, rfl⟩)
    · calc
        ∑ i ∈ s.preimage f hf.injOn, a (f i) =
            ∑ i ∈ (s.preimage f hf.injOn).image f, a i := by
          rw [Finset.sum_image]
          exact fun _ _ _ _ h => hf h
        _ = ∑ i ∈ s with i ∈ Set.range f, a i := by rw [Finset.image_preimage]
        _ = ∑ i ∈ s, a i := by
          apply Finset.sum_filter_of_ne
          intro i _ hi
          by_contra h
          exact hi (hz i h)
        _ = x := hsum

name: Jsp290.completeAfter_reindex_iff
statement:
theorem completeAfter_reindex_iff (a : Sequence) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hz : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range f → a i = 0)
    (D : Finset ℕ) :
    CompleteAfter (fun i => a (f i)) D ↔ CompleteAfter a (D.image f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [CompleteAfter, representsAfter_reindex_iff a f hf hz]

name: Jsp290.exists_positive_model
statement:
theorem exists_positive_model (a : Sequence) (ha : Monotone a)
    (hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i : ℕ, C < a i) :
    ∃ b : Sequence, Monotone b ∧ (∀ i, 0 < b i) ∧
      ∀ D : Finset ℕ, ∃ E : Finset ℕ, E.card = D.card ∧
        (CompleteAfter b D ↔ CompleteAfter a E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hu (|a 0| + 1)
  have hKpos : 0 < a K := by have := abs_nonneg (a 0); omega
  have htail : ∀ i, K ≤ i → 0 < a i := fun i hi => hKpos.trans_le (ha hi)
  let c : Sequence := fun i => |a i|
  have hfront : ∀ i, i < K → c i ≤ a K := by
    intro i hi
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · have h₀ := ha (Nat.zero_le i)
      have habs := neg_abs_le (a 0)
      omega
    · exact ha hi.le
  let f : Fin K → ℤ := fun i => c i
  let σ : Equiv.Perm ℕ := (Tuple.sort f).viaEmbedding Fin.valEmbedding
  have hσfront : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < K),
      σ i = ((Tuple.sort f) ⟨i, hi⟩ : ℕ) := by
    intro i hi
    exact Equiv.Perm.viaEmbedding_apply (Tuple.sort f) Fin.valEmbedding (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin K)
  have hσtail : ∀ i, K ≤ i → σ i = i := by
    intro i hi
    apply Equiv.Perm.viaEmbedding_apply_of_notMem
    rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    change (j : ℕ) = i at hj
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  let q : Sequence := fun i => c (σ i)
  have hqtail : ∀ i, K ≤ i → q i = a i := by
    intro i hi
    dsimp [q]
    rw [hσtail i hi]
    exact abs_of_pos (htail i hi)
  have hqnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i := fun i => abs_nonneg (a (σ i))
  have hqmono : Monotone q := by
    intro i j hij
    by_cases hj : j < K
    · have hi : i < K := hij.trans_lt hj
      change c (σ i) ≤ c (σ j)
      rw [hσfront i hi, hσfront j hj]
      exact Tuple.monotone_sort f (show (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin K) ≤ ⟨j, hj⟩ from hij)
    · have hjK : K ≤ j := by omega
      rw [hqtail j hjK]
      by_cases hi : i < K
      · change c (σ i) ≤ a j
        rw [hσfront i hi]
        exact (hfront _ (Tuple.sort f ⟨i, hi⟩).isLt).trans (ha hjK)
      · rw [hqtail i (by omega)]
        exact ha hij
  let Z := (range K).filter (fun i => q i = 0)
  have hZ : ∀ i, i ∈ Z ↔ q i = 0 := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    · intro hi
      have hiK : i < K := by
        by_contra hn
        have hpos := htail i (by omega)
        rw [hqtail i (by omega)] at hi
        omega
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr hiK, hi⟩
  let b := erase q Z
  have hbpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i := by
    intro i
    have hz := survivor_not_mem Z i
    have hn := hqnonneg (survivor Z i)
    have hne : q (survivor Z i) ≠ 0 := fun h => hz ((hZ _).mpr h)
    change 0 < q (survivor Z i)
    omega
  refine ⟨b, monotone_erase hqmono Z, hbpos, ?_⟩
  intro D
  let F := D.image (survivor Z)
  let E := F.image σ
  have hcard : E.card = D.card := by
    dsimp [E, F]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ σ.injective,
      Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (survivor_strictMono Z).injective]
  refine ⟨E, hcard, ?_⟩
  have hzero : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range (survivor Z) → q i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    apply (hZ i).mp
    by_contra hiZ
    exact hi ⟨Nat.count (fun j => j ∉ Z) i, survivor_count Z hiZ⟩
  have hperm : ∀ i, i ∉ Set.range σ → c i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    exact False.elim (hi (σ.surjective i))
  calc
    CompleteAfter b D ↔ CompleteAfter q F :=
      completeAfter_reindex_iff q (survivor Z) (survivor_strictMono Z).injective hzero D
    _ ↔ CompleteAfter c E := completeAfter_reindex_iff c σ σ.injective hperm F
    _ ↔ CompleteAfter a E := completeAfter_abs_iff a K (fun i hi => (htail i hi).le) E

name: Jsp290.monotone_bounded_eventually_constant
statement:
theorem monotone_bounded_eventually_constant {a : Sequence} (hm : Monotone a)
    (hb : ∃ B : ℤ, ∀ i, a i ≤ B) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, K ≤ n → a n = a K
proof:
:= by
  have hbr : BddAbove (Set.range a) := by
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨B, by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hB i⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hmax⟩ := hbr.exists_isGreatest_of_nonempty (Set.range_nonempty a)
  obtain ⟨K, rfl⟩ := hv
  exact ⟨K, fun n hn => le_antisymm (hmax (Set.mem_range_self n)) (hm hn)⟩

name: Jsp290.prefixSum_constant_tail
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [show K + (r + 1) = (K + r) + 1 by omega, prefixSum_succ,
      ih, hK (K + r) (by omega)]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Jsp290.sum_Ico_constant_tail
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ Ico K (K + r), a i) = ∑ _i ∈ Ico K (K + r), a K := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact hK i (mem_Ico.mp hi).1
    _ = (r : ℤ) * a K := by simp [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: Jsp290.prefixRep_compress_constant_tail
statement:
theorem prefixRep_compress_constant_tail {a : Sequence} (ha : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i)
    {K r : ℕ} (hpos : 0 < a K)
    (hK : ∀ n : ℕ, K ≤ n → a n = a K)
    {x : ℤ} (hx : Represents a x) (hxr : x ≤ (r : ℤ) * a K) :
    PrefixRep a (K + r) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hx
  let u := s ∩ range K
  let v := s \ range K
  have huv : Disjoint u v := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hi hj
    exact (mem_sdiff.mp hj).2 (mem_inter.mp hi).2
  have huvs : u ∪ v = s := by
    ext i
    simp only [u, v, mem_union, mem_inter, mem_sdiff]
    tauto
  have hvsum : (∑ i ∈ v, a i) = (v.card : ℤ) * a K := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ v, a i) = ∑ _i ∈ v, a K := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        apply hK
        have := (mem_sdiff.mp hi).2
        simp only [mem_range] at this
        omega
      _ = _ := by simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ u, a i) + (v.card : ℤ) * a K = x := by
    rw [← hvsum, ← sum_union huv, huvs, hs]
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ u, a i := sum_nonneg (fun i _ => ha i)
  have hvr : v.card ≤ r := by
    by_contra h
    have hlt : (r : ℤ) < (v.card : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast (show r < v.card by omega)
    nlinarith
  let w := Ico K (K + v.card)
  have huw : Disjoint u w := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hi hj
    have hiK := mem_range.mp (mem_inter.mp hi).2
    have hjK := (mem_Ico.mp hj).1
    omega
  refine ⟨u ∪ w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    rcases mem_union.mp hi with hi | hi
    · exact mem_range.mpr (by have := mem_range.mp (mem_inter.mp hi).2; omega)
    · exact mem_range.mpr (by have := (mem_Ico.mp hi).2; omega)
  · rw [sum_union huw]
    change (∑ i ∈ u, a i) + (∑ i ∈ Ico K (K + v.card), a i) = x
    rw [sum_Ico_constant_tail hK v.card]
    exact hsum

name: Jsp290.central_intervals_of_eventually_constant
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i := fun i => (ha i).le
  have hC := prefixSum_nonneg hnonneg K
  refine ⟨K + (PrefixSum a K).toNat, fun N hN x hxlo hxhi => ?_⟩
  have hKN : K ≤ N := by omega
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hKN
  have hcr : PrefixSum a K ≤ (r : ℤ) := by
    have : (PrefixSum a K).toNat ≤ r := by omega
    have hcNat : ((PrefixSum a K).toNat : ℤ) = PrefixSum a K := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hC
    have hcast : ((PrefixSum a K).toNat : ℤ) ≤ (r : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  have hKr := prefixSum_constant_tail hK r
  have hr0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ r := by positivity
  have hpos := ha K
  have hCr : PrefixSum a K ≤ (r : ℤ) * a K := by nlinarith
  by_cases hxr : x ≤ (r : ℤ) * a K
  · exact prefixRep_compress_constant_tail hnonneg hpos hK (hc x hxlo) hxr
  · have hylo : T ≤ PrefixSum a (K + r) - x := by omega
    have hyhi : PrefixSum a (K + r) - x ≤ (r : ℤ) * a K := by omega
    have hy := prefixRep_compress_constant_tail hnonneg hpos hK
      (hc (PrefixSum a (K + r) - x) hylo) hyhi
    exact PrefixRep.complement_iff.mp hy

name: Jsp290.admissible_iff
statement:
theorem admissible_iff (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m < n) :
    Admissible m n ↔ m ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, hm, hrobust, hfail⟩
    by_contra hn
    have hm2 : 2 ≤ m := by omega
    by_cases hu : ∀ C : ℤ, ∃ i : ℕ, C < a i
    · obtain ⟨b, hbm, hbp, htransfer⟩ := exists_positive_model a hm hu
      have hbmrobust : ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = m → CompleteAfter b D := by
        intro D hD
        obtain ⟨E, hE, hiff⟩ := htransfer D
        exact hiff.mpr (hrobust E (hE.trans hD))
      have hbnfail : ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = n → ¬ CompleteAfter b D := by
        intro D hD hc
        obtain ⟨E, hE, hiff⟩ := htransfer D
        exact hfail E (hE.trans hD) (hiff.mp hc)
      exact positive_exclusion hbm hbp hm2 hbmrobust hbnfail
    · have hb : ∃ B : ℤ, ∀ i, a i ≤ B := by
        push_neg at hu
        exact hu
      have hc : Complete a :=
        (completeAfter_of_smaller_card hrobust ∅ (by simp)).complete
      obtain ⟨D, hD, hcD⟩ := exists_completeAfter_card_bounded hm hb hc n
      exact hfail D hD hcD
  · exact admissible_of_le_one m n hmn

name: Jsp290.jsp_000290
statement:
theorem jsp_000290 (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m < n) :
    (∃ a : ℕ → ℤ, Monotone a ∧
      (∀ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = m →
        ∃ T : ℤ, ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x →
          ∃ s : Finset ℕ, Disjoint s D ∧ ∑ i ∈ s, a i = x) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset ℕ, D.card = n →
        ¬ (∃ T : ℤ, ∀ x : ℤ, T ≤ x →
          ∃ s : Finset ℕ, Disjoint s D ∧ ∑ i ∈ s, a i = x))) ↔ m ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  admissible_iff m n hmn
